body.name: Certified partial lag-identification procedure
body.construction: Define \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}\) by the following ordered finite rules.  First, if the input is exactly \(\mathcal W_{\mathrm{out}}\), return \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F_{\mathrm{out}})\).  Second, if the input is the binary lag-switch query of \(\mathrm{def:lag\text{-}switch\text{-}regression}\) with \(x=0\) and \(y=1\), return \(\operatorname{FAIL}(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{lag}}(\mathcal A))\), where the certificate consists of the two displayed rational structural tables and their rational noise laws.  Third, if the directed part of \(H\) is acyclic and has no directed self-loop, construct \(G^\star\), restrict it to \(A^\star=\operatorname{an}_{G^\star}(\{X_{-\gamma},Y_0\})\), and run memoized ordinary ID on \(G^\star[A^\star]\); return \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\) if ID returns \(F\), and return \(\operatorname{UNKNOWN}\) if ID fails.  In every other case return \(\operatorname{UNKNOWN}\).  An ID memo state labels each vertex of \(A^\star\) as absent, random, or fixed, and repeated states are not revisited.  Set \(B_\star(n,L,\gamma)=4+3^{n\{\gamma+(n-1)L+1\}}\).
